findings.text: §50's deliverable rewrites the content and design rubric text and adds a reuse map to the composed design-review brief, but `reckon/crew/review.py:426-431` holds only the *paths* (`_PLAN_REVIEW_PROMPT_PATH`, `_PLAN_DESIGN_REVIEW_PROMPT_PATH`) to `reckon/crew/prompts/plan_review.md` and `reckon/crew/prompts/plan_design_review.md`, which are "read from disk on every call, so editing a rubric is a text change rather than a code change", and the brief body is `prompt + identity lines + scope` assembled at `reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:833-850` — so a worker fenced to `reckon/crew/review.py`, the two skills and the new test cannot change a single dimension the done-when measures, and cannot construct its own negative control

findings.reason: the following clause "no dimension asks the author to cite a symbol or judges a stated method" resolves the ambiguity to a reword of `reasoning` (the only dimension that judges a method), so a worker taking the plan as written lands on the reading that breaks nothing outside its scope.
findings.text: the done-when asserts "the content brief carries a dimension that raises prescribed implementation as a finding", which is satisfied either by adding a rubric item or by rewording `reasoning`, but adding an item changes `review.PLAN_REVIEW_ITEMS` (`reckon/crew/review.py:325-333`) and five tests that enumerate that tuple and generate a report from it — `tests/test_a_bulleted_finding_is_read.py:31`, `tests/test_a_code_report_is_read_by_its_own_grammar.py:29`, `tests/test_a_finding_blocks_its_own_section.py:112`, `tests/test_a_node_is_gated_on_its_own_section.py:108`, `tests/test_a_pass_computes_coverage_once.py:348` — none of which is in the write paths
